query_normalized: leveraging llms for automated generation of code complexity metrics computer science
rationale: The paper focuses on evaluating the *performance* and *capabilities* of LLMs in code generation tasks (completion and infill) across varying code complexities, but it does not address the *automated generation of code complexity metrics* themselves.
